svg.text: STRUCTURAL ZONING • NOT A BUILDING PERMIT DRAWING
54 × 44 m floor, perimeter walls and clear 9 m front vehicle gate.
5.2 m deck above power-cell swap; viewing edge faces lift bays.
Zone partitions and service entries; keep vehicle circulation open.
COORDINATES: Godot X increases right; Z increases downward/front. Existing center floor ring is TEMPORARY — showroom ring moves to zone 06 during implementation.
